verdict.rationale: Gemini Apps documents its own recurring scheduled actions, which run on a daily, weekly or monthly schedule rather than as one-off requests (e.g. a daily news digest). The Daily Brief adds a proactive digest delivered without prompting. However, the evidence only shows time-based digest-style outputs, not broader autonomous automations, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: event-triggered or condition-based automations, evidence that scheduled actions can take autonomous actions in connected apps, documented limits or management of background runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: You can make Gemini a part of your daily, weekly, and monthly routines by scheduling recurring actions. For example, you can schedule actions in Gemini Apps to get: A daily news digest on topics that matter most to you
Start your day with a personalized digest from Gemini. Your Daily Brief understands your rhythms and personal preferences to deliver your top priorities, organized by importance.
